answer.summary: Investigate the per-interval retention rate metric as reported in Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024 to establish empirical evidence for memory retention under periodic input and bounded token budgets.
answer.content: The investigation focuses on verifying the explicit reporting of the per-interval retention rate in Section 4.1 of the specified paper, specifically under conditions of a 50-token update interval and 100-token budget, to determine if observable retention patterns exist within the reported experimental setup. This ensures alignment with directly stated metrics and avoids speculative or ungrounded inferences about memory behavior in tokenized agents.
